content: Multi-tenant RAG leaks above the DB: caching LLM responses keyed only on prompt text rather than (tenant, prompt); logging full retrieved chunks and prompts to a centralized log store so log readers effectively read all tenants; shared vector infrastructure allowing semantically similar chunks to be retrievable cross-tenant. KV-cache sharing between tenants enables prompt reconstruction via TTFT timing side channels (PROMPTPEEK). Retrieved documents entering the context window carry embedded instructions the model cannot distinguish from operator instructions - prompt injection via ingested source. Relying on the LLM for access control is an architectural anti-pattern.
